candidate.description: Load four adjacent fp16 d values through one aligned uint64 and four signed scale bytes through one uint32 per existing qmicro quant quartet, preserving quant decode and every ordered F32 update.

resident_gate.workload: p512/d128 eager c=1, one resident model session, seven counterbalanced control/candidate pairs

protocol.leaf_command: PYTHONPATH=. HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_selected_natural_decode_leaf.py --down-candidate q6-coeff4 --samples 21 --warmups 8 --burst 100 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-q6-down-coeff4-21x100.json
protocol.trace_command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --stats --output-format csv --output-directory /tmp/laguna-q6-coeff4-trace.B01GGV --output-file trace -- .venv/bin/python3 scripts/laguna_selected_natural_decode_leaf.py --down-candidate q6-coeff4 --warmups 1 --samples 1 --burst 1 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-q6-coeff4-trace-child.json
protocol.resident_command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 7 --warmup-rows 128 --compare-q6-selected-down-coeff4-decode --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-p512-d128-q6-coeff4-ab.json

decision.reason: The exact coefficient contraction is a repeatable 3.87-6.78% isolated Q6 leaf win and lowers allocated VGPR, but it loses five of seven full-model pairs and regresses both median throughput and paired wall time under the production two-queue schedule.
decision.next: Keep scalar coefficient loads in Q6 natural down. Require a larger selected-down topology change that reduces complete-family traffic or launches rather than a per-layer transport contraction below the concurrent scheduling noise floor.
